title: Add document deletion that enforces ownership on the server side
request: Add remove(session, id) to the document store in src/docs.mjs. The owner of a document and any admin may delete it. Anyone else is refused with an error whose code is "forbidden"; an unknown document gives "not-found"; a missing or unknown session gives "unauthenticated". A refused delete leaves the document in place. Roles come from the users table the store was created with; nothing but session.userId is trusted from the caller.
seededFailure: The store has create and get with ownership checks, but no remove. The visible check covers the owner and a plain other member. The hidden grader presents a session that carries a forged admin flag and role, an unknown user and a missing document. A feature that trusts the session's own claim of being an admin passes the visible check and fails authorization.
